title: 2-D lid-driven cavity at Re = 1000 vs Ghia, Ghia & Shin (1982)
reference: U. Ghia, K. N. Ghia, C. T. Shin, J. Comput. Phys. 48 (1982) 387-411, Table I (u at x = L/2) and Table II (v at y = L/2); primary-vortex centre (0.5313, 0.5625) L
method: staggered MAC finite volume, conservative van Leer (harmonic TVD) face reconstruction, explicit pressure projection, pressure Poisson with pure-Neumann walls solved by orthonormal DCT-II (compatibility enforced by removing the mean divergence), moving lid through the mirror ghost, grid continuation (bilinear prolongation) as the cost optimisation, cold-start control run to prove continuation does not select the steady state

method_selection.adopted: explicit projection + van Leer + DCT-II Neumann Poisson + grid continuation

rejected.SIMPLE/SIMPLEC implicit outer loop: O(1e3) grid-independent outer iterations would be cheaper, but it replaces the time loop under test; the repo's SIMPLE kernels (staggered_simple.py, inc_bench/solver.py) are inlet/outlet channels, not a closed moving-lid cavity, so adopting it is a new solver, not a re-parameterisation
rejected.vorticity-streamfunction + multigrid (Gh: removes the pressure problem but needs a new discrete system; kept as a cross-check option only
rejected.FAS multigrid acceleration of the projec: the remaining cost lever; needs a coarse-grid operator for the staggered projection scheme and is not required for the 5 % band at n = 64

verdict: PASS at the production resolutions: n=32 (FAIL), n=64 (PASS), n=128 (PASS)

independent_cross_check.field_derived_extrema: dense resampling (4001 samples) of the centreline profile
independent_cross_check.conclusion: the 5 % band is met under the shipped Catmull-Rom rule, under an independent local-quadratic rule (they agree to <0.01 U) and for field-derived extrema, so the verdict is a property of the solution, not of the scorer. Piecewise-linear interpolation is reported as a comparator limit: at the fixed Ghia abscissae it is first order and is limited by the table spacing in the lid shear layer.

reusable_for: any closed-box steady incompressible benchmark in TensorFVM (the DCT-II Neumann pressure solver and the mirror-ghost wall treatment are domain independent)
cross-solver comparison with TensorLBM D2Q9 on the same anchor (same reference tables, same scoring code, so only the discretisation differs)
transfer.cost: explicit projection needs ~104250 steps at n = 128; grid continuation cut the n=64 cost by the measured factor in summary.json -> continuation_check
caveats: cfl = 0.15: the van Leer reconstruction destabilises the lid shear layer at cfl = 0.4
second-order pointwise accuracy only in smooth regions; TVD limiting is active in the lid corner, which is where the residual error lives
time-step (cfl) sensitivity at Re = 1000 was NOT probed this round (steady state should be cfl-independent; marked not_run rather than asserted)
